svg.title: F115 versus baseline B: judge delta as the question set grew
svg.desc: Bar chart of the F115-minus-B judge delta on three question sets: plus 0.66 at n=10, plus 0.12 at the n=15 re-validation round, and minus 0.08 at n=24. The same arm and the same judge produced all three numbers, so the headline did not hold still as the test set grew.

g.text: The headline number did not hold still
F115 vs baseline B — judge delta, same arm, same blind judge.
Only the question set grew. Kept in the log, not edited out.
Read every number next to its n.
